ae_item_base_info_dto.subject: Golf White Wooden Tees Golf Ball Tees 70mm Height Pack of 100/50
ae_item_base_info_dto.detail:
Optimal Height

With a height of 70mm, these tees provide the ideal launch angle for golf balls, enhancing your game.

Generous Quantity

The pack includes 100/50 tees, offering ample supply for multiple rounds of golf without running out.

Versatile Use

These versatile tees are suitable for all types of golf balls, making them a practical addition to any golfer's equipment.

High-Quality Material

Crafted from premium wood, these golf tees ensure durability and longevity, perfect for repeated use on the golf course.
